competition_registrations_type_team_id_c.name: competition_registrations_type_team_id_chk
competition_registrations_type_team_id_c.value: ("competition_registrations"."registration_type" = 'team' AND "competition_registrations"."team_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("competition_registrations"."registration_type" = 'individual' AND "competition_registrations"."team_id" IS NULL)

competitions_cancellation_policy_chk.name: competitions_cancellation_policy_chk
competitions_cancellation_policy_chk.value: "competitions"."allow_cancellation" = false OR ("competitions"."cancellation_cutoff_days" IS NOT NULL AND "competitions"."cancellation_cutoff_days" >= 0)

competitions_participant_confirmation_or.name: competitions_participant_confirmation_order_chk
competitions_participant_confirmation_or.value: "competitions"."participant_confirmation_at" IS NULL OR (("competitions"."registration_end_at" IS NULL OR "competitions"."registration_end_at" <= "competitions"."participant_confirmation_at") AND ("competitions"."event_start_at" IS NULL OR "competitions"."participant_confirmation_at" < "competitions"."event_start_at"))

competitions_cancellation_state_chk.name: competitions_cancellation_state_chk
competitions_cancellation_state_chk.value: ("competitions"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "competitions"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL) OR ("competitions"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "competitions"."cancellation_reason" = 'insufficient_participants' AND "competitions"."status" = 'published' AND "competitions"."minimum_participant_entries" >= 1 AND "competitions"."participant_confirmation_at" IS NOT NULL AND "competitions"."event_start_at" IS NOT NULL AND "competitions"."cancelled_at" >= "competitions"."participant_confirmation_at" AND "competitions"."cancelled_at" < "competitions"."event_start_at")

competitions_participation_confirmation_.name: competitions_participation_confirmation_state_chk
competitions_participation_confirmation_.value: "competitions"."participation_confirmed_at" IS NULL OR ("competitions"."status" = 'published' AND "competitions"."minimum_participant_entries" >= 1 AND "competitions"."participant_confirmation_at" IS NOT NULL AND "competitions"."event_start_at" IS NOT NULL AND "competitions"."participation_confirmed_at" >= "competitions"."participant_confirmation_at" AND "competitions"."participation_confirmed_at" < "competitions"."event_start_at" AND "competitions"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

finance_fee_rules_bounds_chk.name: finance_fee_rules_bounds_chk
finance_fee_rules_bounds_chk.value: ("finance_fee_rules"."minimum_fee_amount" IS NULL OR "finance_fee_rules"."minimum_fee_amount" >= 0) AND ("finance_fee_rules"."maximum_fee_amount" IS NULL OR "finance_fee_rules"."maximum_fee_amount" >= 0) AND ("finance_fee_rules"."minimum_fee_amount" IS NULL OR "finance_fee_rules"."maximum_fee_amount" IS NULL OR "finance_fee_rules"."minimum_fee_amount" <= "finance_fee_rules"."maximum_fee_amount")

finance_payment_events_amount_currency_c.name: finance_payment_events_amount_currency_chk
finance_payment_events_amount_currency_c.value: ("finance_payment_events"."amount" IS NULL AND "finance_payment_events"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("finance_payment_events"."amount" IS NOT NULL AND "finance_payment_events"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "finance_payment_events"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

finance_payment_events_reason_required_c.name: finance_payment_events_reason_required_chk
finance_payment_events_reason_required_c.value: "finance_payment_events"."event_type" NOT IN ('refunded', 'corrected') OR ("finance_payment_events"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("finance_payment_events"."reason") <> '')

finance_payment_events_actor_chk.name: finance_payment_events_actor_chk
finance_payment_events_actor_chk.value: ("finance_payment_events"."actor_type" = 'user' AND "finance_payment_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("finance_payment_events"."actor_type" <> 'user' AND "finance_payment_events"."actor_user_id" IS NULL)

platform_ops_audit_logs_target_present_c.name: platform_ops_audit_logs_target_present_chk
platform_ops_audit_logs_target_present_c.value: "platform_ops_audit_logs"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "platform_ops_audit_logs"."target_institution_id" IS NOT NULL

platform_ops_notes_single_target_chk.name: platform_ops_notes_single_target_chk
platform_ops_notes_single_target_chk.value: ("platform_ops_notes"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_ops_notes"."target_institution_id" IS NULL) OR ("platform_ops_notes"."target_user_id" IS NULL AND "platform_ops_notes"."target_institution_id" IS NOT NULL)

profile_educations_year_order_chk.name: profile_educations_year_order_chk
profile_educations_year_order_chk.value: "profile_educations"."start_year" IS NULL OR "profile_educations"."end_year" IS NULL OR "profile_educations"."end_year" >= "profile_educations"."start_year"

profile_experiences_date_order_chk.name: profile_experiences_date_order_chk
profile_experiences_date_order_chk.value: "profile_experiences"."start_date" IS NULL OR "profile_experiences"."end_date" IS NULL OR "profile_experiences"."end_date" >= "profile_experiences"."start_date"

users_one_verified_role_chk.name: users_one_verified_role_chk
users_one_verified_role_chk.value: "users"."candidate_verified_at" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."recruiter_verified_at" IS NOT NULL
